name: aaa data gatherer
summary: turns video links into compact evidence packs: word-timed transcripts, scene cuts, motion labels, pacing metrics, and timestamped frame sheets. exports PDF, markdown, and JSON for analysis; prepares evidence rather than running a local LLM.
problem: Condense a video into a portable evidence pack that makes its timing, spoken content, cuts, and movement easier to inspect or pass into a later analysis workflow.
highlights: Timed transcripts: Use Whisper word timestamps to connect narration and pauses with the shot timeline.
Visual & pacing evidence: Detect cuts, estimate motion through optical flow, and summarize cutting pace, speaking pace, and loudness.
Portable exports: Produce a PDF report with frame sheets alongside Markdown and JSON for reading or further processing.

sections.heading: The workflow
sections.body:
- Provide video links and select analysis options.
- Download media and transcribe the audio.
- Analyze shots, motion, and pacing.
- Export a report with timestamped frame sheets.

sections.heading: Under the hood
sections.body: Python coordinates yt-dlp, Whisper, video analysis, and report generation. Frame-sampling options balance visual coverage against the size of the evidence pack.

sections.heading: Scope & current state
sections.body: The tool prepares evidence; v1 does not run a local LLM to interpret it. Transcript and optical-flow outputs are estimates, and denser sampling produces larger reports.
